analysis.reasonEn: Following two consecutive down days, an attempted rebound met resistance. RSI remains in neutral territory, while MACD histogram continues to worsen, indicating selling pressure. Volume surged 1.41x the 5-day average, but price is facing resistance near the Bollinger Band middle line. The 52-week position at 42.2% remains low. Lack of clear direction warrants a wait-and-see approach.
